name: tracker-backup-writer-race
goal: Two Tracker databases competing for the same backup directory cannot both publish a backup for the same day.

evidence: Two independent Bun writers with distinct fixture database IDs wrote the same date to a fresh shared directory; both succeeded 6/150 and 12/150 in two runs on 1c759f8dd9. The owner check and replacement are separate operations.

The existing foreign-database standardized case only exercises writers one after the other. Extend the same case with concurrent independent Bun processes sharing an initially empty directory in each attempt, retaining the prior assertions.
